mapper.select: select t.id tableId, t.table_code tableCode, t.table_name tableName, t.is_loop isLoop, t.primary_code primaryCode, t.slave_type slaveType, t.main_table_code mainTableCode, f.id tableFieldId, f.field_code fieldCode, f.field_name fieldName, f.field_type fieldType, m.id, t.sort tableSort, f.sort fieldSort from cbdses_table t inner join cbdses_table_field f on t.id = f.table_id inner join cbdses_export_record_field m on f.id = m.table_field_id where t.is_deleted = 0 and f.is_deleted = 0 and m.is_deleted = 0 and m.export_id = #{exportRecordId} order by t.sort asc, f.sort asc
select code, name from cbdses_export_record_field_content where is_deleted = 0 and field_id = #{fieldId}
